LESSON: MONEY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: MEASUREMENTS
Topic 3.7: Money
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Money, part of MEASUREMENTS in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How is mobile money transaction carried out? 3. Why do we use money in daily activities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Money together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: A learner develops evaluation and decision-making skills as they work out

discounts, commissions and mobile money as well as postal charges and bills.

● Communication and collaboration: A learner develops speaking and listening skills as they role-play negotiating for

discounts and commissions.

46

● Citizenship: A learner develops active social skills as they work out discounts, commissions and mobile money in Kenyan

currency.

● Self-efficacy: A learner acquires negotiation skills as they role-play negotiating for discounts and commissions.

Values:
• Patriotism: A learner develops loyalty as they work out and pay bills in Kenyan currency.

• Integrity: A learner enhances discipline as they pay bills and appreciate use of money.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Financial literacy: A learner practises work out of discounts, commissions and mobile money as well as postal charges and

bills.

● Decision making: A learner develops creativity as they use money in paying bills and postal charges.

Link to other subjects:

● Pre-Technical Studies: A learner works out bills, discounts, commissions and postal charges.

● Life Skills Education: A learner applies negotiation skills in discounts and commissions.

● Languages: A learner gathers information on postal services and charges.
